sftp.backupRecoveryRequired: A previous destination backup needs recovery. The backup is a hidden .tunnelde file beside the destination; it and the transfer record have been kept.
sftp.backupUnrecognized: The file at the recorded backup location cannot be verified as the previous destination. It and the transfer record have been kept; inspect the paths before taking action.
sftp.backupPreserved: The destination was written. Its previous version is kept at the backup path because this connection cannot safely delete a verified file by identity. Review both files and remove the backup yourself if no longer needed, then clear this task. Retrying the transfer will not remove it.

pluginChat.deleteNamedConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and its saved messages? This cannot be undone.
pluginChat.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation and its saved messages? This cannot be undone.

modeHints.ask: Changes and commands require your approval.
modeHints.approve: A separate AI reviews tool actions. Review failures return to you for approval.
modeHints.full: Run tools without individual approval. Commands and CLIs use the execution account's permissions.
modeHints.readOnly: Only bounded read operations are allowed. Arbitrary shell commands are disabled.

pluginChat.fullConfirm: The assistant can call tools without asking each time within the configured scope. Review your folder, SSH and MCP access first. Sensitive operations still require approval.
pluginChat.empty: Describe what you want to work on. Review the provider and tool access before sending.
pluginChat.setupHint: Add an API connection to start a conversation.
pluginChat.recoveryHint: Review saved output before continuing. Tasks are never restarted automatically.
pluginChat.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
pluginChat.targetDisconnected: The selected SSH connection is disconnected.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Search commands and record shortcuts. Changes save automatically. File, editor and terminal shortcuts apply only in their own view. Control shell chords remain available in terminals.
shortcuts.resetBody: Restore all application shortcuts to their defaults?
shortcuts.recordHint: Press keys, then Save. Escape cancels. AltGr and input method composition are ignored.
shortcuts.conflict: Already assigned to {{command}} in this context.
shortcuts.conflictDescription: {{key}} is assigned to more than one command. Choose which binding to keep, or keep the conflict.

filters.title: Filter shortcuts
filters.hint: Use the filter button to find conflicts, modified bindings or plugin commands. Filters can be combined with search text.

profiles.title: Settings profiles
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.nameHint: Use a unique name of 1–64 characters. Up to 32 profiles are supported.
profiles.scope: Includes appearance, behavior, terminal, editor, file view and keyboard preferences, plus proxy profiles and feature routes (without passwords). Hosts, passwords, SSH keys, plugin settings and credentials, history, open tabs and update records are excluded.
profiles.snapshotHint: Profiles are saved snapshots. Editing settings does not change a profile until you choose Update profile.
profiles.empty: No saved profiles. Save your current settings to create one.
profiles.updateConfirm: Replace this saved profile with the current settings.
profiles.deleteConfirm: The current settings will be kept. Only this saved profile will be deleted.
profiles.importHint: Applying replaces software preferences. You can then save them as a named profile.
profiles.discardDraftTitle: Apply settings and discard the CSS draft?
profiles.discardDraft: Your unapplied custom CSS draft will be discarded when these settings are applied.
profiles.invalidName: Use a profile name of 1–64 characters without control characters.
profiles.duplicateName: A profile with this name already exists.
profiles.invalidFile: Choose a valid Tunnelde settings JSON file.
profiles.notRegularFile: Choose a regular settings file. Folders and special files cannot be imported or replaced; export to a file rather than a symbolic link.
profiles.readOnlyFile: The selected settings file is read-only. Choose another destination or make the file writable.
profiles.unknownSetting: The file contains unsupported settings. No preferences were changed.
profiles.invalidValue: The file contains a preference outside its supported range. No preferences were changed.
profiles.unsupportedVersion: This settings file format or version is not supported.
profiles.tooLarge: Settings files must be no larger than 512 KB.
profiles.invalidStorage: Saved profiles could not be read. Current settings are unaffected.
profiles.notFound: This profile no longer exists. Refresh the profiles and try again.
profiles.limit: You can save up to 32 settings profiles. Delete one to add another.

search.invalidQuery: Enter 2 or more characters (up to 256 bytes).
search.busy: Too many searches. Please try again.
search.timeout: Search timed out; narrow the search directory.

network.title: Network & proxies
network.intro: Choose a default route, then override individual features or hosts. Passwords are stored in your system keychain.
network.noProfiles: No saved proxies. Add one to use it across features and hosts.
network.noPlugins: Installed plugins will appear here for individual routing.
network.name: Name
network.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
network.processHint: Process proxies are passed as environment variables to newly started local processes; the executable must support them. System mode inherits the process environment. Restart a running plugin to apply changes. Remote process outbound traffic is managed on the remote host.
network.testSuccess: Connection established through the selected route.
network.invalid: Check proxy addresses, ports and profile names.
network.proxyMissing: The selected proxy no longer exists. Choose another proxy in connection settings.
network.proxyRejected: The proxy rejected the connection or credentials.
network.unsupportedProxy: This proxy protocol is unsupported for SSH. Choose HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5.
network.jumpHint: Connections follow this order. Each jump host uses its own saved credentials and host-key verification. Only the first connection uses the selected proxy.
network.jumpCycle: Use at most eight distinct jump hosts; the target cannot be a jump host.
network.systemHint: System mode uses OS or environment proxy settings and bypass rules. PAC scripts are not evaluated; configure a proxy profile when needed.
network.qualityHint: Measures three TCP/proxy connection setup times, not ping RTT or bandwidth. Port 443 also verifies HTTPS. Other ports send no application data; login is not tested.
network.httpsFailed: The TCP proxy tunnel works, but HTTPS/TLS failed. Check proxy routing, the node and destination before downloading plugins.
network.httpsPassed: HTTPS responded (HTTP {{status}}, {{ms}}); other download domains may differ.

pluginErrors.hostVersionMismatch: This plugin version ({{pluginVersion}}) requires Tunnelde {{required}}; you are running {{hostVersion}}. Update Tunnelde or install a compatible plugin version. Startup stopped before launching a runtime.
pluginErrors.hostVersionUnsupported: This plugin does not support this Tunnelde version. Check the version requirement in Plugin details, then update Tunnelde or install a compatible plugin version.
pluginErrors.spawn: Could not launch the plugin process
pluginErrors.write: Could not communicate with the plugin process
pluginErrors.exited: The plugin process exited or its connection was closed. Open the log for details.
pluginErrors.timeout: The plugin request timed out. Open the log for details.
pluginErrors.unknown: The plugin did not report a reason. Open the log for details.

forward.noHostsHint: Add a host to configure and manage port forwarding.
forward.disconnectBody: Disconnecting stops all forwards using this connection.
forward.title: Port forwarding
forward.hint: Rules are saved per host. Start a rule after connecting; disconnecting stops its listeners and active connections.
forward.empty: Forward a local or remote port through this host's SSH connection.
forward.name: Name
forward.localHint: Listen on this computer and connect to a service through SSH. The destination is resolved by the remote host; 127.0.0.1 means the remote host itself.
forward.remoteHint: Listen on the remote host and connect to a service on this computer. The destination is resolved locally; 127.0.0.1 means this computer. The SSH server must allow remote forwarding.
forward.exposureBody: Listening on {{address}} may allow other devices to reach the destination. Remote exposure also depends on the SSH server's GatewayPorts setting.
forward.deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}” and stop its active connections?
forward.invalid: Enter valid addresses and ports from 1 to 65535.
forward.lock: Port forwarding is busy. Try again.
forward.missing: This forwarding rule no longer exists.
forward.stopBeforeEdit: Stop this forwarding rule before editing it.
forward.alreadyActive: This forwarding rule is already running.
forward.bindFailed: Could not listen on that address and port. It may already be in use.
forward.remoteRejected: The SSH server rejected the remote forward or did not respond. Check its forwarding policy and listen address.
forward.stopFailed: Could not confirm that the listening port was released. Disconnect this host's forwarding connection before trying again.
forward.purpose: What do you want to access?
forward.nameHint: Optional. Defaults to the service address and port.
forward.connectionRequired: Connect to this host to start forwarding.

request.invalid: Check the remote directory and local mount point.

mounts.notOwned: This mount belongs to another plugin.

mounts.startTimeout: The directory did not finish mounting in time. Check the SSH connection and FUSE driver.
mounts.pathTimeout: The mounted directory did not respond in time. Check the connection and try again.

mounts.unmountTimeout: Unmounting timed out. Close files using this directory and retry.

mounts.stdout: Could not open the SSHFS output channel.

install.windows: Install WinFsp and SSHFS-Win, then restart Tunnelde. Drivers are never installed automatically.
install.macos: Install compatible macFUSE and SSHFS packages, approve any required system extension, then restart Tunnelde.
install.linux: Install your distribution's SSHFS and FUSE packages. Ensure your user can access /dev/fuse.
install.transport: This SSHFS build lacks the required stdin/stdout transport. Choose a build advertising the slave or passive option.

logs.noFile: No diagnostic log is available yet.
logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Inspect recent operations and application diagnostics.
logs.operationsHint: Records host changes, SSH connections and plugin installation activity from this version onward. Passwords, commands and file contents are not recorded here.
logs.diagnosticHint: Recent entries from the latest application log. Diagnostics can contain private information; review before sharing.

restart.requiredBody: The storage changes are scheduled and will take effect when Tunnelde restarts. Save your work before restarting.
restart.restartWarning: Restarting disconnects sessions, interrupts background tasks and discards unsaved edits. Save your work first.
restart.reloadWarning: Reloading the window may interrupt active views and discards unsaved edits. Save your work first.
restart.nativeOnly: Restart is available in the desktop application.

storage.title: Storage locations
storage.description: Choose where each kind of application data is stored. Select several categories to move them into separate folders under one parent folder.
storage.searchTerms: storage migration data database plugins chats conversations keys runtime cache logs runners folders paths locations disk
storage.resetHint: Existing data at the default location will be archived for recovery before the current data is copied back. Other storage categories remain in place.
storage.overridden: Managed by TUNNELDE_PLUGINS_DIR. Change that environment variable to relocate this folder.
storage.startEmpty: Start with empty storage; keep the original data
storage.confirmHint: Data will be copied and verified before the app opens it on the next start. Destinations must be empty or new. Originals are kept as recovery copies. Current sessions and transfers continue using their current locations until you quit.
storage.emptyWarning: Existing data will NOT be copied. This category starts empty.
storage.restartHint: Finish your work, fully quit Tunnelde (including the tray), then open it again. Closing only the window does not apply these changes.
storage.keptOriginals: These copies are no longer updated. Check the new locations before manually removing any original data.
storage.boundaries: System keychain credentials and your external keys, workspaces, downloads and remote files stay in their existing locations. The small storage.json location index stays in the original application data folder; locations are excluded from settings profiles and exports. Plugin-owned absolute paths may need updating in that plugin.
storage.migrationFailed: Migration did not finish. The app is using the original locations. Cancel the plan and choose new empty destinations, or correct the conflict and fully restart to retry.
storage.invalidPath: Choose an absolute folder path without parent-directory segments.
storage.targetNotEmpty: The destination must be an empty or new folder. Existing files will not be overwritten.
storage.invalidPlan: Select at least one different destination, with each category selected only once.
storage.pathOverlap: Storage folders cannot overlap each other or the source data.
storage.notEnoughSpace: The destination disk does not have enough free space for this migration.
storage.linkUnsupported: This storage category contains a symbolic link, junction or unsupported file. Choose a different destination or remove the link from the category before migrating.
storage.tooManyFiles: This storage category exceeds the migration limit (200,000 entries or 64 directory levels).
storage.verificationFailed: Copied data does not match the original. The original locations remain active.
storage.invalidConfig: The storage.json location index is invalid. Restore it from a known good copy.
storage.planPending: Cancel the scheduled migration before choosing a new plan.
